title: Fragment dispatch can leave its temporary target in the DOM
author: OskarEichler
body_preview: ## Description  Experimental Fragment `dispatchEvent` inserts a private temporary node at the Fragment position, but listener/node cleanup only runs after a normal native dispatch return. title: Browser server task queue drains in quadratic time
author: OskarEichler
body_preview: ## Description  The browser server stream scheduler stores pending callbacks in an array and removes one per `MessageChannel` delivery with `Array.shift()`. A burst of concurrently queued render work repeatedly moves the remaining callbacks, making queue draining quadratic in the number of scheduled tasks.  ## Reproduction  Drain a pre-filled FIFO with the current shift-based operation and compare...
